Backend engineer with 5 years of experience building payment and billing
systems in Python and Go. Strong focus on correctness under concurrency,
idempotency, and observability. Led the migration of a monolith's billing
module into an event-driven service without customer-visible downtime.

Backend Engineer II — Ledgerline (2021–present)
- Own the invoicing service (FastAPI + PostgreSQL): 2M invoices/month,
 four-nines availability target.
- Designed the idempotency-key scheme for payment webhooks; duplicate charge
 incidents went from ~3/month to zero.
- Migrated billing out of the Django monolith into a separate service
 communicating over Kafka, using the strangler-fig pattern and dual-writes
 with reconciliation jobs during the cutover.
- Introduced OpenTelemetry tracing across five services; cut mean
 time-to-diagnosis for cross-service incidents roughly in half.

Software Engineer — Brightmoor Systems (2019–2021)
- Built REST APIs (Flask, later FastAPI) for a logistics platform;
 introduced database migrations with Alembic and zero-downtime deploy
 practices (expand/contract schema changes).
- Optimized a hot N+1 query path, dropping a dashboard load from 8s to 300ms.

Junior Developer — Cobalt Web Agency (2018–2019)
- Full-stack work on client sites; first exposure to production incidents
 and postmortems.

Python, Go, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker,
Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, property-based testing,
distributed systems patterns (sagas, outbox, idempotency).
